reviews.rationale: All three claims are supported by a single high-quality source (Ref 15, NCT02308228). The citation traces confirm that all specific p-values mentioned in the claims (p=0.003, p<0.001, p=0.005, p=0.020, and p=0.007) are explicitly present in the source abstract. There are no missing citations for direct claims, and the role matches are consistent across the submission.

The claims are highly calibrated and narrowly scoped. Rather than making broad generalizations about metformin's effect on muscle mass across all populations, the submission reports specific, statistically significant findings from a single study (NCT02308228). The claims accurately reflect the direction of the effect (placebo performing better in lean mass gains) and include the associated p-values, avoiding any attempt to inflate the clinical significance or extrapolate these results to a general population without qualification.

The submission is exceptionally well-supported. The Evidence Auditor confirmed that every specific p-value cited across the three claims is explicitly present in the source text (Ref 15/NCT02308228). The Domain Skeptic correctly noted that the claims are narrowly scoped to the study's findings, avoiding overgeneralization. Since both prior reviewers are in full agreement and the citation traces show a 100% match for the quantitative data, there is no dissent to weigh. The evidence is direct, verified, and accurately reported.
